name: subscript
description: A stable x with a lowered numeral two.
useCase: Apply subscript in a text editor.
misuse: Expose pressed state on the formatting button.

16.reason: The x is identical in both script variants. Only the numeral changes vertical position; shifting the entire icon would break toolbar baseline alignment. Text master: 1.5px construction.
